# Metadata Enrichment Service Overview

The Metadata Enrichment Service, also known by its aliases `mes` and `enrichment-service`, is a component within Metadata Enrichment Frameworks. It is specifically designed to automatically generate and append semantic metadata to datasets.

# Semantic Tagging Engine Overview

The Semantic Tagging Engine (also known as STE or semantic-tagger) is a metadata enrichment framework designed to analyze dataset contents. Its primary function is to apply standardized semantic tags and classification labels to datasets. This process enhances metadata by adding structured, meaningful descriptors derived from the content itself, aiding in discovery and organization.

# Metadata Discovery Portal Overview

The Metadata Discovery Portal (also known by its aliases `mdp` or `metadata-portal`) is a centralized interface designed to facilitate the search, discovery, and exploration of enriched dataset metadata across the enterprise. It falls under the category of Data Curation and Quality, providing a critical tool for managing and understanding data assets within an organization.

# Lineage Tracking System Overview

The Lineage Tracking System, also known by its aliases `lts` and `metadata-lineage`, is a system designed to track the provenance, transformations, and historical flow of metadata assets. It is categorized under Data Curation and Quality, highlighting its role in understanding the lifecycle and changes of metadata for metadata enrichment purposes.
